name: Notary & apostille (category guide)
summary: SAL-listed notaries, e-Apostille, and embassy translation paths for LTVP packs, US forms, and overseas affidavits — fee-capped, not character-billed overseas quotes.
body: Singapore Academy of Law appoints Notaries Public and issues authentication / e-Apostille for notarised documents — SAL does not notarise for you. Start at the SAL directory, confirm whether the receiving authority wants notarisation only, apostille, or embassy legalisation, then book a notary near you. Notarial fees are regulated; page-based overseas translation-plus-apostille quotes of thousands of dollars for LTVP packs are a common Reddit failure mode — ask your embassy in Singapore for accepted translators first. Commissioners for Oaths handle statutory declarations for many local uses; notaries handle documents destined abroad. Pair immigration counsel when the pack is a common-law LTVP affidavit, not when you only need a signature witnessed.
whenToEngage: Overseas form needs Singapore notarisation / apostille
LTVP or PR pack needs certified translation sequencing
Embassy list of translators beats home-country character quotes
Statutory declaration vs notarised affidavit is unclear
